faqs.label: Scripbox My First Crore plan
faqs.header: Invest Rs. 5000/ p.m to reach your first crore
faqs.info: Invest in small amounts every month for a few years to accumulate your first crore. Scripbox My First Crore plan will help you invest in the best performing funds for the goal.

faqs.label: Scripbox Retire Confident plan
faqs.info: We will help you create a personalised retirement plan to maintain your lifestyle in retirement. Check Scripbox Retire Confident plan.

faqs.label: Scripbox Child Education plan
faqs.header: How much should I invest for my child's education?
faqs.info: We help you invest enough for your child's education. Today, your child's education is a costly affair. Plan early and stay ahead. Check out Scripbox Child Education plan.

faqs.label: Scripbox Dream Planner
faqs.header: Plan your dream with Investment planner
faqs.info: Dream big and make it a reality by saving up rather than taking a loan. Check out Scripbox Dream Planner to estimate monthly savings to fulfil your dreams.

faqs.label: Scripbox Tax Saver Plan
faqs.header: Save money with tax saver plan
faqs.info: Wish to save tax and optimize your investment portfolio? Benefit from equity investment along with tax saving with Scripbox Tax Saver Plan.

faqs.label: Scripbox Emergency Fund plan
faqs.header: How do I keep an emergency fund?
faqs.info: Wish to build a fund for your emergency needs? Invest in stable and secure liquid funds with the Scripbox Emergency Fund plan

faqs.label: Scripbox Principal Protection and Growth plan
faqs.header: Invest Rs. 5000/ p.m to reach your first crore
faqs.info: Are you the kind of investor who believes in playing it safe but also wants  to grow their wealth? Explore Scripbox Principal Protection and Growth plan

faqs.label: Scripbox Goal based Plans
faqs.header: Plan today to meet your life goals
faqs.info: Have life goals? Invest in the best funds chosen carefully to fulfil your dreams. Check out Scripbox Goal based Plans

faqs.label: Consolidated mutual fund statement
faqs.header: Get Insights of your consolidated mutual fund statement
faqs.info: Get your mutual fund portfolio analysed for free by uploading your consolidated mutual fund statement with Scripbox.
